original_method: Prove common target identity; capture GPU population, UUID, PCIe/slot topology and power/load state; collect full command lists and eight Web rows inside a bounded interval; map every ordinal to stable hardware; normalize fields and compare to SPEC without clearing logs or resetting/changing GPUs.
manual_activity: A GPU/platform reviewer approves the BMC ordinal-to-slot/UUID map and power-state-aware limits, then visually confirms all eight Web rows.

safety_requirements: Do not reset GPUs or change power/performance state
Redact secrets and identifiers as required
Capture eight explicit members and full lists
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Normalize fields and timestamps per mapped GPU
engineer_actions: Approve GPU ordinal-to-hardware map and SPEC

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `TEMP_GPU0~7` sensor-get cannot enumerate eight devices or map them to hardware; truncated SDR omits IB, full lists and Web.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete command views and eight explicit Web sensors, joined to read-only UUID/slot inventory and contemporaneous GPU power/load state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five interfaces, eight GPUs and timing metadata remain; generic clear, range-literal and truncated evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an eight-row matrix keyed by immutable GPU UUID and physical slot, attaching BMC ordinal, power/load state, all five timestamped views and SPEC outcome.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable hardware identity and runtime-state context.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ordinal swaps after service or reboot can associate a valid temperature with the wrong GPU and conceal a hot or missing device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC and driver thermal sources may measure different locations; driver data is topology context unless the SPEC explicitly declares equivalence.

project_override_considerations: Define expected GPU population, ordinal-to-UUID/slot map, measurement plane, power-state behavior, fields, limits and temporal tolerance. Private Script use requires pinned review.
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/serial/PCIe/slot map plus power/load state
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Eight protected Web rows and page context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target eight GPU sensors across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek's incomplete range query are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: GPU mapping, inventory, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if ordinals cannot be tied to hardware after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Introduces stable per-GPU identity and runtime context so eight plausible readings cannot mask swapped, absent or powered-off devices.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU indices can change with enumeration and service events, while thermal behavior depends on power and workload. Therefore ordinal labels and temperature plausibility are insufficient; UUID/slot binding and contemporaneous state are required before comparing five management representations.
